test_full_range: test the full_range function to generate a list of numbers from start to end with a given step
test_iterable_list: test the IterableList class to iterate over a list of items including nested ListProduct objects
test_list_product: test the ListProduct class to generate all combinations of values from a list of scalars and iterables
test_table_product: test the TableProduct class to generate all combinations of values from a dictionary of scalars and iterables
run_generator_tests: run the unittest test suite for the generator module covering full_range, IterableList, ListProduct, and TableProduct
